analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but is consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement, but a trend reversal is not yet confirmed. ADX at 18.1 indicates a weakening trend, making a wait-and-see approach prudent.

· 52-week Position (35.9%) + Current price range is a recovery phase from historical lows

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($366.55): Short-term resistance, potential for upward reversal on breakout

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Observation needed for indicator changes
